Full final is more conservative for actual behavior, while incremental explicitly says cessation is not established. Frozen count wording failed to exclude functional replacement explicitly, so classify as a strict-oracle mismatch plus a design ambiguity, not an unambiguous material regression.
core_quality.corroboration_difference: Full final explicitly compares contextual cowrunamuck backups with A11 satisfaction-linked stock-up; incremental retains that contextual testimony but joins only A04/A11 for broader satisfaction-before-buying. Full wording says independently but also admits Reddit independence unverified and says no distinct source-role route despite community/retailer roles. Keep qualified descriptive recurrence; neither unqualified independent corroboration nor a clean comparative quality win follows.
